input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Raindrops Keep Fallin' on My Head"?

documents.text: Keep Fallin ' on My Head is the twenty-fifth studio album by American pop singer Andy Williams and was released in the spring of 1970 by Columbia Records . [ 1 ] Williams was less focused on covering recent hits on this project and instead selected several songs from the singer-songwriter genre .
